entries.subject: Archive access and query interface
entries.finding: Arecibo collapsed in 2020. Its asteroid radar survives as Planetary Data System bundles: Doppler spectra of 167 asteroids observed from December 2017 to December 2019, plus its contributions to the radar detection and shape-model compilations. NASA states that the wider planetary radar archive is held by NSSDCA, and about three petabytes of telescope data moved to a Texas supercomputing centre with no public access date.

entries.subject: Proprietary period, licence and credit
entries.finding: Planetary Data System data are in the public domain and are expected to be cited; the Arecibo bundle asks that its own paper be cited.

entries.subject: Reduction software
entries.finding: Only finished spectra are distributed; the bundle ships example Python that documents the format rather than a reduction package, and no raw Arecibo radar bundle exists.
entries.revisitWhen: Raw Arecibo radar data or its processing code are published.
